JUDGE BURST K1p-adv-jdg — the Keeper's ADVANCED gear stills vs the starter master. task_id "K1p-adv-jdg". Separate instance; no prompts or receipts.

Image 1 is the starter master (plain walnut staff tip, no pauldron). Images 2, 3, 4 are candidates that each CLAIM to be the same woman with exactly two additions: a small brass ASTROLABE (nested open rings + pointer arm) at the staff tip, and a chestnut-leather PAULDRON on her LEFT shoulder (screen-right) carrying a small brass emblem of a vertical needle through three stacked bands. Everything else must be identical to Image 1. For EACH candidate: astrolabe_present, pauldron_present, pauldron_side ("her left / screen-right" | "her right / screen-left" | "absent"), emblem_legible (yes/no), extra_changes (list anything else that differs from Image 1: face, hair, pose, costume, colours, framing), mirrored (true/false); scores 1–5 identity_preservation, gear_quality (register fidelity of the additions), and one-line reasons. Name best (image number). Write out/judgment.json {"candidates":[…], "best":n, "why":"…"}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1p-adv-jdg"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]. Never PASS/FAIL.
